notes: Documents End as terminal and adds target-existence/reachability rules, but incorrectly makes an explicit End node optional without conditioning that on an explicit nonempty [End] target; the reachability rule is not fully terminal-aware. It also edits dialogue_graph.py outside the organizer-listed target file.

Adds pointer-events:none for visual overlays and a bidirectional linked-selection acceptance checklist, but omits the required real-browser center-click test and mandatory fix/retry after intercepted-pointer or click-timeout failures.

Excludes failed/killed lifecycle events and waits for completion, but permits FINISH or an equivalent terminal state and emits zero by default for jobs with no SUBMIT. Gold requires exact FINISH-only completion and no output for lifecycle-only keys with no qualifying activity.
Explicitly accepts JOB_FINISH or JOB_KILL as completion and lacks the qualifying-activity gate. It therefore satisfies neither exact FINISH-only completion nor lifecycle-only output suppression.
Explicitly treats finish, fail and kill as terminal completion, contradicting the FINISH-only target. Existing RI-002 Gold guidance remains present.
Adds generic output, formatting and wait-for-completion guidance but not the has-qualifying-activity state gate or lifecycle-only negative rule. Existing RI-001 Gold guidance remains present.

Covers the RI-001 deliverable and completion contract. RI-002 is not satisfied: it chooses a handbook-listed or most-noncompliant sensor rather than always selecting the global minimum TAL with lexicographically smallest tc_id only on exact ties.
Covers the RI-001 output and completion contract. RI-002 chooses a handbook representative or most-noncompliant sensor when both bounds exist instead of the unconditional global minimum TAL.
Adds the required output artifacts, exact schemas and literals, validation-before-finish and missing-data behavior. Existing RI-002 global-minimum-TAL rule remains present.

Makes a handbook-mapped sensor win and adds peak-temperature tie-breaking before lexical order. Gold requires unconditional minimum TAL and lexical tc_id only on exact TAL ties. Existing RI-001 Gold guidance remains present.

Corrects the problem-aware save-plan signature and schema input, but does not require PDDLWriter(problem).write_plan, forbid str/manual serialization, or enforce exact-file parse plus validation round trip.

RI-002 correctly preserves every positive gap. RI-001 uses a causal full convolution truncated to input and returns an uncorrected frame index, retaining lag. RI-003 is internally inconsistent about threshold direction and omits defaults-first/evidence-not-target-duration requirements.

Uses same-length centered edge-padded convolution and returns an original-timeline index; downstream guidance explicitly forbids an extra offset. Existing RI-002 and RI-003 Gold content remains present.

Defines half-open intervals, sorts and clamps them, merges overlap or exact touching only, preserves every positive gap, and makes the normalized list authoritative. Existing RI-001 and RI-003 Gold content remains present.

Corrects threshold_ratio direction and provides tuning guidance, but does not require running documented defaults first or forbid tuning toward a target compression duration. Existing RI-001 and RI-002 semantics remain intact.

Implements much of the cross-quarter Top Buys aggregation, but uses repo-relative paths instead of required /skills paths and defines stock count as distinct CUSIPs rather than rows after the helper TITLEOFCLASS filter. It also broadly modifies helper scripts outside the organizer target files.

Changes examples to repo-relative 13f-analyzer/scripts and fuzzy-name-search/scripts paths, but the runtime contract requires absolute /skills/... paths from /root. Supplied RI-002 and RI-003 Gold guidance remains semantically present.
Defines stock count as unique filtered CUSIPs. Gold defines Number of stock holdings as rows remaining after the helper TITLEOFCLASS filter. Other supplied Gold repairs remain present.

Uses quarter-specific accession identifiers and a helper-backed pipeline that filters the stock universe, aggregates VALUE by CUSIP, outer-joins quarters, fills missing values with zero, ranks positive dollar deltas descending and emits CUSIPs in deterministic order. Existing RI-001 and RI-002 guidance remains present.
Adds generic Maven/toolchain/Invoker guidance but not the exact JDK7 historical-CI reproduction contract or the concrete AutoValue functional-POM dependency synchronization required by the targets.

Adds generic wrapper/toolchain checks but not the exact openjdk7 switch, historical CI command, failure record and patch/apply/verify sequence. Existing RI-002 concrete dependency guidance remains present.

Adds generic nested Invoker diagnostics but not the concrete jsr305, JUnit, Guava and guava-testlib synchronization scoped to value/src/it/functional/pom.xml. Existing RI-001 JDK7 contract remains present.
